evidence.title: Globe Telecom SEC Form 17Q – 1Q 2026: STT Fairview 1 Update
evidence.publisher: Globe Telecom, Inc. via Philippine Stock Exchange EDGE
evidence.attribution: Globe Telecom, Inc. and Philippine Stock Exchange EDGE
evidence.excerpt: Globe's first-quarter filing says STT Fairview 1's structure and Level 1 data halls were complete, Level 2 was commissioning, and Level 3 remained in design during the quarter.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 1460276-byte public official filing attachment response body
metadata.physical_status_scope: The facility contains simultaneous completed, commissioning, and design scopes. A single whole-project commissioning or operational label would overstate the evidence, so the conservative current observation is expansion.
metadata.capacity_context_as_reported: STT GDC Philippines was positioned to exceed 30MW of total capacity within the year.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The >30 MW platform forecast is untyped, future, and spans sites; it creates no facility or campus capacity row.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The filing, extracted text, headers, and curl writeout were deleted after validation and are not redistributed. Globe's own CDN returned 403 and is not treated as a successful source capture.

evidence.title: STT GDC Philippines Metro Manila Data Centres
evidence.excerpt: The current Metro Manila page identifies STT Fairview 1 as the first of four Fairview campus buildings and reports 28 MW IT load for it.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 89733-byte public official HTML response body
metadata.capacity_scope: The page names Fairview 1 as the first of four buildings and reports separate IT loads for Fairview 1 through 4. Their arithmetic sum is normalized once as a planned campus total; Fairview 1's 28 MW is a nested planned project row and must not be added again.
metadata.status_guardrail: The marketing label does not override the filing's level-specific physical update and is not used to infer commissioning, completion, or operation for the whole facility.
metadata.capture_guardrail: The credential-free body, raw headers, and curl writeout were deleted after exact validation.

capacities.notes: Arithmetic sum of the four distinctly named Fairview building IT-load values on one current official campus page: 28 + 32 + 32 + 32 MW. It is planned portfolio capacity, not current load; the nested Fairview 1 row must not be added again.
STT Fairview 1 IT load as reported on the current page. It remains planned capacity because the filing documents mixed complete, commissioning, and design scopes rather than full-facility operation.
